# Journalism Climate v1.0.12

> Useful TypeScript functions for journalism projects. This library focuses on calculations and data fetching related to climate.

- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nshiab/journalism-climate/v1.0.12/README.md): Installation, examples and usage.

## API
- [getEnvironmentCanadaRecords](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nshiab/journalism-climate/v1.0.12/docs/functions/getEnvironmentCanadaRecords.md): getEnvironmentCanadaRecords function
- [getHumidex](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nshiab/journalism-climate/v1.0.12/docs/functions/getHumidex.md): getHumidex function
- [getSeason](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nshiab/journalism-climate/v1.0.12/docs/functions/getSeason.md): getSeason function
